profile.research_note: [batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility, referred to as Valero Wiserman, is located in Bexar County, Texas, the county containing San Antonio, home to the headquarters of Valero Energy Corporation, a Fortune 500 petroleum refining and marketing company and one of the largest independent refiners in the world. This is consistent with an enterprise data center supporting Valero corporate headquarters operations rather than a refinery specific control system; the Center for Land Use Interpretation documents Valero San Antonio headquarters campus as a significant corporate real estate presence in the city. As a large industrial and energy company, Valero is expected to operate substantial internal IT infrastructure supporting refining operations, logistics, trading, and corporate administration, but a published source describing this facility specific capacity, construction history, or function beyond its Bexar County location was not found. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
